questions.subject: Math AA HL
questions.syllabus_ref: AHL 5.18 (first order differential equations; integrating factor)
questions.challenge_mechanism: Name the single mechanism that makes this hard, in one full sentence. 'Multi-step' is not a mechanism. Say what the student has to notice, reject, or invert.
questions.question: The stem. Sets the scene, gives the data, and introduces anything a later part refers back to.

parts.label: a
parts.text: A complete, self-contained sub-question. At least eight words.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Each part must depend on the previous one, or at least be useless without it.

parts.label: c
parts.text: Part marks must sum exactly to the marks field.

questions.answer: Full worked solution. Every award annotated (M1)(A1)(R1)(AG) at the point it is earned. Aim well above 190 words for maths, 440 for CS.
questions.markscheme_notes: Alternative methods, condonations, follow-through, and what forfeits a mark. Minimum 125 words.
questions.explanation: The key insight, why the question is hard, and the classic wrong turns. Minimum 195 words for maths.

provenance.adaptation: Required unless inspired_by is 'original'. State what was borrowed and what changed.

verification.method: How every number was checked: analytic recompute, numerical solve, code executed, or hand trace.
